findings.title: Task screen returns a raw 500 when an admin removes hints from a published task after the child opened some
findings.resolution: PracticeMapping shows only the opened hints that still exist (minOf(opened, total)); remaining stays >= 0. PracticeIT "the task still loads after the admin removes hints the child had opened".

findings.title: An old replay run comes back to life when a task is added to the mission later, so attempts go into the replay scope instead of the primary one
findings.resolution: practice_run.finished_at is set by the attempt that resolves a replay run's last task; currentRun ignores finished runs, so a task added later goes to the primary scope. PracticeIT "a finished replay stays finished when a task is added to the mission later".

findings.title: NFR-5 check round-trip test does not follow the scenario's fixture or load shape
findings.resolution: PracticeTimingIT now seeds 10 published tasks covering all seven answer types incl. a two-part task, and times 200 graded submissions after 20 warm-ups, alternating attempt 1 (wrong) and attempt 2 (correct) with fresh runs from startReplay (p95 173 ms on the loaded laptop). The Compose-stack measurement is the frontend e2e timing test that plan §4.7 assigns to the frontend half.

findings.title: TC-6 'Feedback never comes from AI' is only half enforced: no network-denied run of the attempt tests
findings.resolution: DenyOutboundNetwork (test extension): while PracticeIT runs, the default ProxySelector refuses every non-local connection the JDK opens through java.net and each test fails if one was attempted; a self-check proves a public address is refused. The dependency check stays in TutorTest.

findings.title: Malformed body on a task that is not served returns 400, not the required 404
findings.resolution: Controllers call PracticeService.requireServed before reading the attempt or report body, so invalid fields for an unserved task are 404. Only a body over 16 KB or not one JSON object is refused before the lookup (request level, design Error handling). PracticeIT "an invalid body for a task that is not served is 404, not 400".

findings.title: 'Replay of an unfinished mission is refused' is only tested for a NEW mission, not one in progress
findings.resolution: PracticeIT "an in-progress mission cannot be replayed and the rank-up body has the 16 KB limit" (409, no run created, progress unchanged).

findings.title: No backend test for the 413 'Request body too large' scenario on rank-up acknowledgement
findings.resolution: Same test: rank-up acknowledgement over 16 KB is 413 problem+json.

findings.title: 'Same input, same feedback' is verified only at unit level, not across two fresh runs through the API
findings.resolution: PracticeIT "the same wrong input gives the same feedback and parts in two fresh runs" compares the feedback object and parts of a primary run and a replay run through the API.

findings.title: Undocumented 400 for non-UUID path ids on endpoints whose OpenAPI lists only 200/404 (or 200/204/404)
findings.reason: Contested minor, no change: the contract info Conventions state for every operation that a path id that is not a UUID is 400 before any lookup ("a path id that is not a UUID is 400 before any lookup"); the child operations follow that documented convention like the admin ones of slices 5 and 6. Listing 400 on each operation would be a docs-store contract change for the owner.
